tools.description: List the benchmark and validation cases shipped with rcfd and the built-in case templates.
tools.name: list_cases

tools.description: Create a simulation session from a template, TOML text, a settings object or a case file. Returns the session id and makes it the default session.

path.description: path of a .toml/.json case file inside the sandbox

tools.name: create_case

tools.description: Set one setting by dotted path, e.g. solver.alpha_u or boundaries.lid.velocity_value. Named entries (boundaries.<patch>, reports.<name>) are created on demand. Refused while a run is active.

session.description: Session id; defaults to the session made by the last create_case

tools.name: set_setting

tools.description: Read one setting by dotted path, or the whole settings tree when path is omitted.

session.description: Session id; defaults to the session made by the last create_case

tools.name: get_setting

tools.description: Use a mesh file (Gmsh .msh or an OpenFOAM polyMesh directory) instead of a generator.

session.description: Session id; defaults to the session made by the last create_case

tools.name: load_mesh

tools.description: Build the mesh and return its quality report (non-orthogonality, skewness, aspect ratio, errors, warnings) and patch list.

session.description: Session id; defaults to the session made by the last create_case

tools.name: check_mesh

tools.description: Start the solver and wait up to wait_seconds for it to finish. Returns the run state; a run that is still going keeps running in the background (poll with status).

session.description: Session id; defaults to the session made by the last create_case

tools.name: run

tools.description: Run state, iteration, time, latest residuals and report values.

session.description: Session id; defaults to the session made by the last create_case

tools.name: status

tools.description: Monitor histories (res_u, res_p, continuity and report values) as x/y arrays; use since to fetch only newer samples.

session.description: Session id; defaults to the session made by the last create_case

tools.name: get_residuals

tools.description: Min, max, mean and volume average of a field (ux, uy, uz, p, speed, ...).

session.description: Session id; defaults to the session made by the last create_case

tools.name: get_field_stats

tools.description: Write the current solution as a VTK .vtu file inside the sandbox and return its path.

session.description: Session id; defaults to the session made by the last create_case

tools.name: export_vtk

tools.description: List the tasks of the session's set-up/run workflow with their state (not_run, done, failed, stale), dependencies and the next task to run; also lists the available templates and task kinds.

session.description: Session id; defaults to the session made by the last create_case

tools.name: list_workflow_tasks

tools.description: Create the session's workflow from a template (mesh_to_results, channel_flow, empty), from a workflow document, or by loading a workflow file from the sandbox.

path.description: workflow JSON file inside the sandbox

session.description: Session id; defaults to the session made by the last create_case

tools.name: create_workflow

tools.description: Insert a task into, or delete a task from, the session's workflow. Deleting is refused while other tasks depend on the task; inserting validates ids, kinds, dependencies and cycles.

after.description: for insert: id of the task to insert after (default: at the end)

session.description: Session id; defaults to the session made by the last create_case

task.description: for insert: {id, kind, title?, deps?, params?}

tools.name: edit_workflow

tools.description: Run one workflow task (and, by default, the prerequisite tasks that are not done), or all outstanding tasks when task is omitted. Stops at the first failing task and reports its message. Solve tasks run synchronously under the service limits.

session.description: Session id; defaults to the session made by the last create_case

tools.name: run_workflow_task

tools.description: Check a case without running it (the --check-only launch): settings, simulation set-up and mesh quality. Give a session, or a case file path inside the sandbox. Returns the exit code the CLI would use (0 ok, 3 invalid, 4 bad mesh).

session.description: Session id; defaults to the session made by the last create_case

tools.name: check_case_headless

tools.description: Run the session under the run-control contract: step and wall-clock limits, stop file, continue from a checkpoint, periodic/final checkpoints and a machine-readable status stream written to a file. Blocks until the run ends; returns the outcome (state, exit code, iterations) and the last status events.

interpolate_case.description: case file of the source mesh; with interpolate_checkpoint, initialise from that solution (F-115)

interpolate_checkpoint.description: checkpoint written for the source case

out_dir.description: write solution.vtu, monitors and report.html here at the end

session.description: Session id; defaults to the session made by the last create_case

status_path.description: write the JSON-lines status stream here

tools.name: run_headless

tools.description: Summarise a status stream file (JSON lines, format rcfd-status) written by `rcfd run --status-json/--status-file` or run_headless: final state, exit code, iterations, last residuals, checkpoints and warnings.
tools.name: read_status_stream

tools.description: Define a design study in a directory inside the sandbox (writes study.json): named parameters with bounds mapped to settings paths, operating conditions, objectives with robust mode (mean, worst, mean_plus_k_sigma, weighted), constraints and a sampler or optimiser (factorial, lhs, sobol, nelder_mead, differential_evolution). The base case is a case file or the settings of a session.

base.description: base case file inside the sandbox

chain.description: start each condition from the previous converged one (default true)

conditions.description: {label, set:{settings path: value}}; default one condition 'base'

dir.description: study directory (study.json and evaluations.jsonl live here)

method.description: {type, budget?, restarts?, seed?, pop?, levels?, n?}

objectives.description: {metric, sense: min|max, weight?, robust?, k?, weights?}

parameters.description: {name, lo, hi, init?, path | targets:[{path, scale?, offset?}]}

session.description: Session id; defaults to the session made by the last create_case

tools.name: design_create_study

tools.description: Write a variant case file: a base case file, or a study with parameter values, plus settings overrides, validated through the settings tree. Returns the file path and the settings fingerprint. Refuses to replace an existing file unless overwrite is true.

path.description: variant case file to write (.toml or .json)

tools.name: design_create_variant

tools.description: Run an operating map: points over settings values (grid of axes, or an explicit list), each restarting from the previous converged solution; writes map.csv and map.json to out_dir and returns per-point status, restart kind, iterations and all report values. A repeated identical call returns the stored table without running. Bounded by max_design_evaluations.

axes.description: {path, values} or {path, start, stop, count}; first axis slowest

dir.description: study directory (instead of base) with params for a variant

tools.name: design_run_operating_map

tools.description: Run the study's sampler or optimiser with the case solver, appending every evaluation to the study store; stops after max_evaluations new evaluations (bounded by max_design_evaluations) and continues from the store on the next call. Returns the best record and the Pareto front.
tools.name: design_run_study

tools.description: Evaluate one candidate of a study (all its operating conditions) with the case solver and store the result; a candidate already in the store is returned without running.
tools.name: design_evaluate

tools.description: Record metrics computed elsewhere (for example by running the case through the other tools) for a candidate of a study. Metric values must be finite numbers; give metrics for a single-condition study or conditions [{label, metrics}] for several.
tools.name: design_record

tools.description: Metrics of one stored evaluation of a study (by record index or exact parameter values), or the table of an operating map (map_dir).
tools.name: design_get_metrics

tools.description: Compare stored evaluations of a study side by side: parameters, metrics per condition, exact metric differences against the first record and a ranking by the study objective (feasible first).
tools.name: design_compare_variants

tools.description: The next candidate(s) the study's sampler or optimiser asks for, given the evaluations stored so far. Deterministic and free of side effects; evaluate or record them, then call again. complete is true when the method has nothing more to ask.
tools.name: design_propose

tools.description: Definition, evaluation counts, best feasible record and Pareto front indices of a study.
tools.name: design_list_study

tools.description: Append one evaluated variant to a design ledger (a JSON-lines file in the sandbox, created on first use): named parameters and metrics with units, evaluator id and version, geometry/mesh hash, settings, verdict (ok, diverged, constraint_rejected, not_evaluated; a located reason is required unless ok), fidelity tier. The solver version and a timestamp are stamped. Returns the entry index.

ledger.description: ledger file inside the sandbox, e.g. fan/ledger.jsonl

metrics.description: [{name, value, unit}]; value may be null when the verdict is not ok

settings.description: what is needed to re-run (case settings, overrides, operating point)

tools.name: design_ledger_append

tools.description: Read a design ledger: entries filtered by kind, verdict, study, evaluator and fidelity (paged), plus optionally the Pareto-optimal entries for [{metric, sense}], the best entry and running best-so-far trace for {metric, sense}, and the history of one parameter. Pareto and best use ok evaluation entries of one evaluator and tier with consistent units (filter first when the ledger mixes them). Torn or foreign lines are reported in skipped_lines.
tools.name: design_ledger_query

tools.description: Export the (filtered) entries of a design ledger to a CSV file (one column per parameter and metric with its unit; numbers round-trip exactly) or a JSON file inside the sandbox.
tools.name: design_ledger_export

tools.description: Compare the metrics of a re-run (done with the entry's evaluator, settings and parameters) with ledger entry index: per metric recorded, new, absolute difference and whether it is within atol + rtol |recorded| (defaults 0: bit-identical); units, missing metrics and the verdict are checked too.
tools.name: design_ledger_rerun_check

tools.description: Render a field as a PNG image (optionally with velocity vectors) and return it as an image content block.

session.description: Session id; defaults to the session made by the last create_case

tools.name: render_image
